text.tspan: Multi-AZ web tier: no single point of failure in one region
Route 53 alias → ALB (optional CloudFront + WAF)
Application Load Balancer
public subnets in 3 AZs · health check /health
AZ a
public subnet: NAT gateway (one per AZ)
private subnet: EC2 from launch template
(ASG member, no public IP)
RDS primary (writer)
AZ b
public subnet: NAT gateway (one per AZ)
private subnet: EC2 from launch template
(ASG member, no public IP)
RDS standby (sync copy)
AZ c
public subnet: NAT gateway (one per AZ)
private subnet: EC2 from launch template
(ASG member, no public IP)
Aurora replica / spare
Auto Scaling group spans all three private subnets · health_check_type = ELB · instance refresh for deploys
Stateless instances: sessions in ElastiCache/DynamoDB/DB, files in S3. Over-provision per AZ: losing 1 of 3 AZs removes a third
of capacity at once. Prove it: terminate an instance, force an RDS failover, run an AZ fault-injection test.
